prescribedGeometry.description: Exact A1.4 prescribed display paths with zero axial half-separation, coincident endpoint orbit centers, the indexed 3:2:1 frequency relation, and independently selected radii and phases.

choices: The flattening coordinate lambda_A=0.35 is illustrative.
Every binary midpoint is the braid origin in the relative frame; h_a=0 and rho_a=R_a make each endpoint pair traverse one common geometric circle.
The base frequency f=0.25 and all non-ratio binary coordinates are prescribed display choices.
Normalized linear axis interpolation is illustrative between the taxonomy-defined endpoints.
